data.title: Fake school shooting threat a cover for a late delivery
data.description: RATCHABURI - Officials closed a school serving 3,000 students on Wednesday after receiving a shooting threat, only to find out later that a sports day jersey supplier had used it to postpone a delivery.

data.title: Dozens dead in catastrophic Nepal-Tibet floods
data.description: Hundreds missing as torrents of water and mud wash away buildings in border region

data.title: Abhisit says borrowing B400 billion won’t spur growth
data.description: Democrat Party leader Abhisit Vejjajiva has outlined four reasons for rejecting an emergency decree authorising the government to borrow 400 billion baht, warning that its passage would do little to change Thailand’s economic growth prospects while leaving people exposed to an ongoing energy crisis.

data.title: Prince Harry and family arrive back in Britain
data.description: LONDON - Prince Harry, his wife Meghan and their two children landed Wednesday in Britain, UK media reported, after the surprise news emerged last week they would be relocating from the United States.

data.title: Nile crocodiles in France hatch unaided amid heatwave
data.description: LYON - The heatwaves that have beset France have produced an unusual outcome at a wildlife park, where 10 Nile crocodiles hatched without human assistance for the first time, the director of the reserve said on Wednesday.

data.title: Suvarnabhumi road maintenance to disrupt traffic
data.description: Suvarnabhumi airport in Bangkok has advised passengers to plan their journeys in advance and allow extra travel time as a maintenance project will block some traffic lanes to and from the passenger terminal from next Monday to April 7 of next year.

data.title: 32 villagers fined for stealing shrimp from crashed truck
data.description: Thirty-two residents of Lampang have been fined 10,000 baht each for stealing almost 1.2 tonnes of shrimp worth around 300,000 baht from a truck after it crashed in Thoen district in the northern province in March.

data.title: France eases cow diet rules to help cheesemakers
data.description: PARIS - Widespread drought and record-breaking heatwaves have forced France to relax some of its famously strict rules on cheese production, with authorities on Wednesday announcing special measures for abondance, beaufort and comte cheeses.

data.title: Nepal floods kill eight, cause ‘major casualties’ in Tibet
data.description: NUWAKOT, Nepal - Massive flooding killed eight people in Nepal on Wednesday as Chinese state media reported “major casualties” from a mudslide at a Tibet trade hub on China’s side of the nations’ shared border.

data.title: MDES-depa celebrates success of coding Thailand 2026
data.description: The Ministry of Digital Economy and Society (MDES), through the Digital Economy Promotion Agency (depa), has announced the success of Coding Thailand 2026: AI Inspires the Future, a project aimed at promoting coding and artificial intelligence (AI) skills among Thai students and teachers nationwide. More than 12,000 students and teachers from across the country registered toparticipatein the project. After completing a series of learning activities and knowledge assessments, 3,224 participants from 806 teams were selected to take part in the regional competitions.

data.title: Five fined for somersault stunt on Chon Buri road
data.description: CHON BURI — Five women have been fined for safety violations after a video showing them dancing, using hula hoops and performing somersaults in the middle of Sukhumvit Road in Sattahip went viral.

data.title: Alcohol explosion in science class causes injuries at Yala school
data.description: A science experiment went wrong at a school in Yala province on Wednesday, after alcohol exploded in a classroom, injuring teachers and students.

data.title: Chon Buri plant faces illegal waste disposal charges
data.description: Industry Minister Varawut Silpa-archa has ordered legal action against a Chinese-owned factory for dumping 700 tonnes of industrial waste outside its factory in Chon Buri province.

data.title: FDA approvals boost Thailand's vaccine self-reliance
data.description: <p>Thailand has taken steps to strengthen its vaccine supply, with a nine-strain HPV vaccine and a botulinum antitoxin registered by the Food and Drug Administration (FDA).</p>

data.title: Shield Insurance Broker Wins Best Customer Experience Initiative in Thailand 2026
data.description: Shield Insurance Broker, operated by Ngern Tid Lor Public Company Limited, a subsidiary of Tidlor Holdings (TIDLOR), won the Best Customer Experience Initiative in Thailand under the Retail Finance Digital and Frictionless Awards category at The Asian Banker Thailand Awards 2026 . This reflects its success in transforming its role from an insurance broker into a Service Broker. The focus goes beyond selling policies to prioritizing relationship building and continuous customer care throughout the coverage journey. This ranges from pre-purchase consultation, sales, and 24-hour after-sales care, to claim coordination and status tracking. The service model integrates the Shield Insurance Broker Call Center 1501, where a team of experts is on standby 24/7 for emergency coordination, ensuring our customers truly experience peace of mind from purchase to claim."

data.title: Nene Royal revives Soundgarden’s ‘Black Hole Sun’ on AGT
data.description: Nene Royal’s AGT performance has renewed interest in Soundgarden’s 1994 grunge classic, which Chris Cornell wrote in about 15 minutes.

data.title: America unites in mourning for Dolly Parton
data.description: LOS ANGELES - Americans of all stripes united to grieve the passing of country music legend Dolly Parton, offering a rare moment of agreement as presidents of both parties joined entertainment and business giants in paying tribute.

data.title: US aircraft carrier’s visit ‘for relaxation only’
data.description: The upcoming visit of the USS Abraham Lincoln carrier strike group to eastern Thailand next week is purely for crew relaxation and no joint military operations are planned, according to the Ministry of Defence.

data.title: MQDC Launches Mulberry Grove The Forestias, a Super Luxury Multi-Generational Condo
data.description: Magnolia Quality Development Corporation Limited (MQDC) has launched Mulberry Grove The Forestias Condominiums, a super luxury low-rise condominium development spanning over 16 rai within The Forestias. Construction is now complete, and the project is ready for occupancy. The development stands out for its expansive surrounding greenery and design approach that seamlessly integrates nature with urban living, under the concept of Nurturing Multi-Generational Living — creating a residence where every member of the family, across every generation, can live and thrive together.

data.title: MINISO × LISA stages its first global pop-up at Bangkok’s ICONSIAM
data.description: MINISO and LISA’s first global pop-up lands at Bangkok’s ICONSIAM, bringing ALTEREGO collectibles, fashion accessories and a Thailand-exclusive Muay Thai purse.

data.title: Loewe makes buckled-up fashion statement
data.description: The fashion internet has been dissecting the latest footwear from Loewe, which appears to have taken the idea of “wearing the brand” quite literally.

data.title: Thailand Focus 2026 spotlights digital and New Economy investment
data.description: Thailand Focus 2026 brought 77 listed companies before global investors as the SET highlighted digital infrastructure and New Economy opportunities.

data.title: Thai MPC holds 1.00% policy rate while economic growth remains subdued
data.description: Merchandise exports and private investment linked to the technology and AI cycle are outperforming expectations, but their benefits to the Thai economy remain limited in scope.

data.title: 'Our patron saint': Tennesseans mourn local heroine Dolly Parton
data.description: SEVIERVILLE, Tennessee - With Dolly Parton's "Jolene" filling the night air, fans of the late country music icon laid flowers at a Tennessee statue of the singer who changed their US state forever.

data.title: Nene Royal rocks on into America’s Got Talent final
data.description: Thai rock star Nene Royal has made history by reaching the Grand Final of America’s Got Talent ( AGT ) following a high-energy performance in the Live Show round that impressed the judges so much that she was awarded a Golden Buzzer.

data.title: Stolen Picasso print resurfaces in vacant apartment
data.description: A Pablo Picasso print stolen from an art gallery in the US city of Milwaukee in 2018 has resurfaced after more than eight years, turning up in an unlikely place: a vacant apartment undergoing an eviction clean-out.

data.title: Road traffic at Suvarnabhumi may be disrupted Aug 31-April 7
data.description: Suvarnabhumi airport in Bangkok has advised passengers to plan their journeys in advance and allow extra travel time as a maintenance project will block some traffic lanes to and from the passenger terminal from next Monday to April 7 of next year.

data.title: Citizenship bust targets 5,000 ‘fake Thais’ in Chiang Mai
data.description: CHIANG MAI — Local administrators and migrants were among 20 suspects arrested in this northern province as part of a fake citizenship bust believed to involve about 5,000 “fake Thais” made in just one district.

data.title: Coordinated attacks: Thailand's southern insurgency flares
data.description: A surge in attacks across Thailand's South has put a spotlight on the low-level insurgency by Muslim separatists that has killed thousands of people in the last two decades.

data.title: Nene Royal wins global fans with surprise Soundgarden cover
data.description: The 16-year-old Thai singer surprised viewers with Soundgarden’s Black Hole Sun as fans worldwide praised her vocals, guitar work and presence.
